notes.claim: A function gives a single output for any input, so on its graph each input meets the curve at one height.
A horizontal line that cuts the graph of y = x² more than once shows two different inputs giving the same output, so that function is many-to-one.

sources.title: About the HELM Project
sources.quote: A function is a rule which operates on an input and produces a single output from that input.

sources.title: About the HELM Project
sources.quote: We see that a horizontal line drawn on the graph cuts it more than once. This means that two (or more) different inputs have yielded the same output and so the function is many-to-one.
